start_policy: pi0 = STAGE0 of the parent project (base + LoRA r32 SFT on 187 S0 + 561 S1/S2/S3 train reference trajectories, lr 1e-4, 1 epoch, seed 0, merged)
model_selection: dev split only: highest dev `overall` (macro success over suites); tie (|diff| < 0.005) -> lower dev false_outage_rate
final_evaluation: test and heldout, once per selected frozen adapter, greedy, identical suites and graders
primary_outcome: heldout overall success (paired cluster bootstrap by BFCL base task vs pi0 and A vs B)

budget.abort_rule: after the 3-step benchmark, abort if projected total > 5 h; then drop the second lr of each grid (keep CSO default 5e-6 for DPO and 1e-4 for SFT) before cutting anything else
